# E0142: a schema or lens refers to something declared outside the lineage

A schema refers to a definition declared outside the lineage, at the top of
the file. Editing the definition would edit every version that refers to it,
published ones included (reference rule ref-outside-lineage). Each schema
declares the definition it uses.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
#Color: "red" | "blue"

lin: {
	name: "ship"
	schemas: {
		"0": "0": {
			schema: {c: #Color}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0142]: c in schema 0.0 refers to #Color, which is declared outside the lineage
 --> lineage.cue:7:16
  |
7 |             schema: {c: #Color}
  |                         ^^^^^^
  |
  = note: reference rule ref-outside-lineage
  = help: a schema may refer only to its own body and CUE's builtin packages
```
